scope: Descriptor exchange on the same image using fixed trained selectors and cached score vectors.
aggregation: Average repeated seeds and task-pair rows within image, then weight images equally. Bootstrap resamples images.
panel_scope: Exchange-eligible anchor-image panel; these accuracies are not balanced binary-task benchmark accuracies.
task_split_scope: Unseen combinations are primary and seen combinations secondary; their task collections differ, so their contrast alone is not a pure transfer effect.
quartile_boundary_rule: An exact boundary belongs to the higher-numbered stratum.

artifact_schema.outcome_suffix: First letter selects descriptor; second letter selects classification task. ba means descriptor B evaluated on task A.
artifact_schema.source_rows: source_row_a/b and image_only_row_a/b refer to row_id in the parent predictions artifact.
artifact_schema.row_unit: One training seed, one image and one unordered pair of distinct tasks sharing the true class.
artifact_schema.image_only_prefix: Same exchange evaluation using the matched image-only selector; expected exact null.
